# Virtual Office: agent team

ALWAYS INVOKE `tech-pm` FIRST: send every software request to Scrum Master, the orchestrator, and don't implement it yourself. It puts the work on the Kanban board. Already running as a team role? Follow your role prompt instead.

Team: `tech-pm` (Tech Scrum Master, orchestrator → `web-tech-lead`); `web-tech-lead` (Tech Lead → `web-dev`); `web-dev` (Developer). In OpenCode each role is an agent (`.opencode/agent/<id>.md`).

## Dispatching (the top-level agent)
Roles started as subagents cannot start subagents, so the top-level agent dispatches:
1. Start `tech-pm` with the subagent tool and the user's request as given. Don't explore the project first; the roles read what they need.
2. For each `HANDOFF <KEY> -> <agentId>` line in a reply (respecting `dependsOn`), start that agent with only: `Your task: <KEY>. Start it with curl -s -X POST "$(cat .agents/portal-url 2>/dev/null || echo http://localhost:3000)/api/tasks/<KEY>/start" (prints the card), then follow your role prompt.`
3. Repeat for the HANDOFF lines they return until the requirement card is done, then tell the user what was delivered.
